title: Debiasing Large Language Models toward Social Factors in Online Behavior Analytics through Prompt Knowledge Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance (Macro-F1 scores) on intent and theme detection tasks by comparing baseline Zero-CoT prompts with prompt strategies augmented with explicitly generated social-attribution knowledge (contextual summaries and user goals) to measure the models' uneven reliance on situational versus dispositional causality.
